Here's the corrected `.fd` source. My previous attempt mistakenly emitted the *Markdown embed wrapper* (the `![...]` image line and `<sub>source: ...</sub>` footer) as if it were the FigDown document itself — that's Markdown, not FigDown, hence the parse errors on line 1 and 3. Below is the actual FigDown flowchart source that should live at `figures/changerequest.fd`.

One caveat worth flagging: I don't have `reference/experimental/flowchart.md` in front of me in this session, so the node-type keywords (`process`, `decision`, `terminator`) and the grouping construct (`frame … { … }`) for "change window" are composed from the patterns shown in the core skeleton doc rather than confirmed against the flowchart genre file itself. Please run `node build-svg.js changerequest.fd` and fix any line errors the validator reports for the exact spellings — per the doc, "the parser never warns" about experimental-vs-normative status, but it *will* reject a wrong keyword outright, and the error message should name the correct one if I've guessed wrong.

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 flowchart
title "Change request procedure"

process receive "Receive change request"
process validate "Validate against policy"
decision isvalid "Valid?"
process apply "Apply change to device"
terminator confirm "Confirm success"
terminator rollback "Roll back"

# Groups validate + apply visually to show what falls inside the
# scheduled maintenance window; carries no other meaning.
frame window "Change window" {
  validate
  apply
}

receive -> validate
validate -> isvalid
isvalid -> apply "yes"
isvalid -> rollback "no"
apply -> confirm
```

Once it builds clean, embed it in the host document like this (image + source footer, never the `.fd` content itself):
